mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity_id = #{id} ORDER BY history_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM crm_opportunity_lost_detail WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity_id = #{id} ORDER BY detail_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM crm_opportunity_lost_detail WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT quote_id, customer_id, contract_id, version FROM crm_quote WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity_id = #{id} ORDER BY quote_id
SELECT contract_id, tenant_id, customer_id, currency, status, version, deleted, signed_flag, start_date FROM oa_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contract_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_receivable WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contract_id = #{id} ORDER BY receivable_id
SELECT * FROM outbox_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND aggregate_id = #{id} AND aggregate_type = 'cloudflow-service-oa' AND event_type = 'CONTRACT_PERFORMANCE_CHANGED' ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM crm_deal_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND biz_type = #{type} AND biz_id = #{id} ORDER BY event_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_invoice_writeoff writeoff LEFT JOIN oa_invoice invoice ON invoice.invoice_id = writeoff.invoice_id AND invoice.tenant_id = writeoff.tenant_id LEFT JOIN crm_deal_event event ON event.tenant_id = writeoff.tenant_id AND event.event_key = CONCAT('OA_INVOICE_RECEIPT:', writeoff.invoice_id, ':', writeoff.writeoff_id) AND event.biz_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND event.biz_id = #{id} AND event.event_type = 'RECEIPT' AND event.customer_id = invoice.customer_id AND event.amount = writeoff.writeoff_amount AND event.baseline_flag = 0 AND event.reversal_of_id IS NULL WHERE writeoff.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND writeoff.business_type = 'CRM_RECEIVABLE' AND (invoice.receivable_id = #{id} OR writeoff.business_id = #{id}) AND (event.event_id IS NULL OR invoice.receivable_id IS NULL OR invoice.receivable_id != #{id} OR writeoff.business_id != #{id})
